name: Fenmark Wide-Leg Denim
description: High-rise wide-leg jeans in heavyweight raw denim that softens and creases to the wearer's body over time. A straightforward silhouette that's been in and out of fashion for two centuries — currently just in. Available in raw indigo and one-wash light blue. The back pockets are generously sized.
what_it_says: You have a sense of style that doesn't need explaining. You know what you like.
worn_by: anyone with casual confidence in their look
story_hooks: Raw denim fades in patterns unique to the wearer's body — a forensics-trained eye could estimate someone's gait from the crease lines.
A character buys these secondhand and spends weeks wondering about the person whose wear patterns are already set into the fabric.

physical_description.visual_profile: Commanding silhouette with a relaxed, almost architectural stance. High-rise waistband sits well above hip bones, creating a long vertical line from waist to ankle. Wide legs taper minimally, pooling slightly at the cuff. Projects understated confidence and timelessness.
physical_description.fit: High-rise, roomy through hip and thigh, generous straight leg from knee to hem. Comfortable and unrestricted—designed for all-day wear and movement. Not form-fitting; allows layering underneath.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavyweight raw denim (14-16 oz), untreated indigo or one-wash light blue. Designed to age and develop unique creasing patterns specific to the wearer.
physical_description.texture: Initially stiff and crisp with visible diagonal weave; softens with wear and washing. Raw indigo version retains nubby texture and will develop natural fading lines. One-wash version slightly broken-in, softer from initial treatment.
physical_description.color_scheme: Raw deep indigo (almost black-blue) or light-wash pale blue. Minimal contrast stitching in cream or off-white. Clean, timeless palette.
physical_description.closures: Button fly with traditional metal hardware. Five-pocket construction with reinforced seams at stress points.
distinctive_features: Generously sized back pockets designed for personal items and tools
Raw, selvedge-edge seams visible along inseam
High-rise waistband for secure fit and elongated torso silhouette
Minimal branding—subtle Fenmark tag on back waistband
Heavy-duty copper rivets at pocket corners
Designed for indigo-crocking and personalized wear patterns
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover. Quality construction and heritage design signal corporate-adjacent taste, but accessible price point and utilitarian function appeal to skilled working class.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by archivists, logistics coordinators, independent techs, and neo-heritage enthusiasts who value durability over augmentation-forward fashion. Statement of pragmatism and temporal fluidity—wearing something 'timeless' in 2226 reads as countercultural.
physical_description.condition_typical: Raw indigo version arrives stiff and pristine, develops unique whisker creases, fading along inseams, and a worn patina at stress points within 6-12 months of wear. One-wash version more immediately wearable, showing gentle lived-in character.
